fluff.overview: Foot infantry squads are small-formation variants of standard dismounted infantry, organized at squad strength for missions requiring fewer troops than a full platoon. Squad-sized foot elements serve as security detachments, observation posts, building garrisons, and independent patrol teams where a full platoon would be excessive or unavailable. Their smaller footprint makes them easier to transport and conceal, though they lack the sustained firepower and casualty absorption of larger formations.
